Rizzle, named in-game as Goblin Brawler, is a goblin brawler who greets the party if they enter the Shadow-Cursed Lands from the Mountain Pass during Act Two.
“
Don't stick about. A torch will keep you safe - more or less.
„
— Rizzle

Involvement

Act Two

Rizzle meets the party if they enter the Shadow-Cursed Lands through the Mountain Pass. She assumes the party are True Souls and asks them to grab a torch and move to meet up with the convoy, beginning ⁠Follow the Convoy.

Combat

 Throw Stone ()
Damage: 1~4
1d4⁠Bludgeoning
Throws a sharp stone at a foe.
 Range: 9 m (30 ft)

Loot

  • Goblin Scimitar

Speak with Dead

If the party leaves the area and comes back, they find Rizzle dead on the floor.  Speak with Dead can then be used on her corpse to find out more information.

  • Who are you?
    • Goblin Brawler
      Ri... Rizzle...
  • What happened to you?
    • Goblin Brawler
      Curse... Them shadows... Got teeth too...
  • Who killed you?
    • Goblin Brawler
      Not... Who... What...
  • Where are you from?
    • Goblin Brawler
      Moonrise... Towers...
  • I need to find Moonrise Towers. How do I get there?
    • Goblin Brawler
      To the... east... Need a... torch...
  • What was your job?
    • Goblin Brawler
      Work and die... In her name... Absolute...
  • How do I survive the curse?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse says nothing. Perhaps if she knew, she wouldn't be dead.*
